from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CrimeDetail(BaseModel):
    """A crime mentioned in a judgment document."""
    crime_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific crime name mentioned")
    crime_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader category the crime belongs to")

class DocumentAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """Analysis of a single judgment document for crime-related content."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Document identifier (e.g., 'Document 1')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., '刑事申诉审查处理通知', '行政非诉执行复议裁定书')")
    crimes_mentioned: list[CrimeDetail] = Field(description="All crimes mentioned in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_analyses: list[DocumentAnalysis]
